title: agentctl claude doctor isolation report, version 1
description: The `isolation`/`isolation_policy` half of `agentctl claude doctor`'s report (plan AC58). Not yet reachable through a CLI flag; this schema is what a future `doctor --json` would emit, and is validated today against the type `render::json::DoctorReport` builds directly. It carries no token material: nothing here is read from a credential, only from `.claude.json`, a symlink target, and a settings file.

version.description: The report version. A consumer must refuse a version it does not know.

isolation.description: One entry per `<acct>/<org>` directory found under `session_root()`. Empty when no isolated session exists.

id.description: The registry id this session belongs to, or `unregistered`.

seeded_keys.description: The top-level key names of the seeded `.claude.json`, sorted; empty when it was never seeded.

leaked_keys.description: `seeded_keys` intersected with the never-seed allowlist. Non-empty is an error condition.

unexposed.description: Top-level entries of the live config directory that are on neither allowlist, sorted.

forget_command.description: The exact command that tears this session down.

securestorage_dir.description: What CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR would be set to.

config_dir.description: What CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR would be set to — the session path itself.

sha8_match.description: Whether sha8(securestorage_dir) equals the registry's recorded export_sha8. False for an unregistered or non-owned session.

linked.description: Whether mcp.json is a symlink at all.

credential_entries.description: How many mcpServers entries in the target file carry a non-empty env or headers object. Null when the target could not be read or parsed.

changed_since_seed.description: Whether the live file is newer than the seed. Informational, not an error.

disable_sideload_flags.description: policySettings.disableSideloadFlags, read from the live settings.json and the managed profile. Null when neither file sets it.

backend_observable.description: Always false: agentctl cannot observe which secure-storage backend a session activates from outside it.
